def parse_one_edit(lines):
    filename = lines.pop(0) if lines else ""
    text = "\n".join(lines)
    if DIVIDER in text:
        before, after = text.split(DIVIDER, 1)
    else:
        before = ""
        after = text
    before = before.replace(HEAD, "").strip()
    after = after.replace(UPDATE, "").strip()
    return Edit(filename, before, after)
